tests.title: Java foundations practice
tests.description: A short original practice set with immediate explanations.

questions.prompt: Which type stores a true/false value?

questions.explanation: `public` and `private` control access. `static` controls ownership; `final` prevents reassignment or extension.

questions.prompt: Write a complete `Main` program that reads two integers and prints their sum.
questions.explanation: Read both values, add them, then print the sum.
questions.reference: public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { java.util.Scanner s = new java.util.Scanner(System.in); System.out.println(s.nextInt() + s.nextInt()); } }

questions.prompt: Complete `square(int n)` by writing its method body.
questions.explanation: Multiplying an integer by itself gives its square.
